name: AnimatedList-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Five rows read clearly, with one lit row and soft fades at both edges.

tagline: Rounded rows scroll by, one lit under the pointer.
summary: A tall column of short status messages in rounded dark rows scrolls inside a fixed panel, with rows fading at the top and bottom. Hovering a row brightens it and arrow keys walk the selection.
appearance: A narrow column of rounded charcoal rows, each holding one line of white text, sits centred on black. The first and last rows fade into the background and one row is a shade lighter than the rest.
behaviour: The list scrolls vertically inside a fixed height while its top and bottom rows soften out. Moving the pointer or pressing arrow keys walks a highlight down the rows, and clicking one selects it.
demo_content: Status lines like "Invoice #4021 paid by Northwind Labs" and "Production deploy succeeded in 42s".
search_phrases: list with fade at the edges
use_when: A compact panel should show many short updates or options in a scrollable column.
avoid_when: Long text or images per row: the 500px width and 400px height clip content.
customise: Items, a select handler, gradients, arrow-key navigation, scrollbar, class names and the initial selection are props. Row colours are hardcoded dark values.
weight_why: A dozen text rows with simple in-view scale tweens.

a11y.note: Arrow keys and Enter work, but rows are plain divs with no roles and a global key hook, and motion ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The top and bottom rows are heavily faded, so edge items are hard to read.
polish_why: Tidy dark rows and smooth fades; it is a standard list with little identity.
title: AnimatedList
